```{r}
library(tidytext)

library(textdata)
library(stringr)
library(tidyverse)

```

```{r}
tpab_raw <- discog_data %>% filter(grepl("To Pimp a Butterfly|pimp a butterfly", album, ignore.case = TRUE))
```

```{r}
afinn_lexicon <- data.frame(
  word = c("good", "great", "love", "happy", "positive", 
           "bad", "terrible", "hate", "sad", "negative"),
  value = c(3, 4, 3, 2, 2, -3, -5, -3, -2, -2)
)
extract_thematic_features <- function(lyrics_text) {
  if (is.na(lyrics_text) || nchar(lyrics_text) == 0) {
    return(data.frame(
      sentiment_mean = 0,
      sentiment_volatility = 0,
      sentiment_range = 0,
      theme_justice = 0,
      theme_self = 0,
      theme_spirituality = 0,
      theme_money = 0
    ))
  }
  
  words <- tibble(text = lyrics_text) %>%
    unnest_tokens(word, text)
  
  sentiment_words <- words %>%
    inner_join(afinn_lexicon, by = "word")
  
  if (nrow(sentiment_words) > 0) {
    sentiment_mean <- mean(sentiment_words$value)
    sentiment_volatility <- ifelse(is.na(sd(sentiment_words$value)), 0, sd(sentiment_words$value))
    sentiment_range <- max(sentiment_words$value) - min(sentiment_words$value)
  } else {
    sentiment_mean <- sentiment_volatility <- sentiment_range <- 0
  }
  
  # Custom theme dictionaries for TPAB
  themes <- list(
    theme_justice = c("oppression", "power", "fight", "racism", "police", 
                      "justice", "inequality", "protest", "black", "white"),
    theme_self = c("i", "me", "my", "mine", "myself", "self"),
    theme_spirituality = c("god", "faith", "pray", "heaven", "hell", 
                           "sin", "bless", "soul", "spirit"),
    theme_money = c("money", "cash", "dollar", "cost", "rich", 
                    "poor", "price", "wealth", "broke")
  )
  
  # Calculate theme densities
  word_list <- unlist(strsplit(tolower(lyrics_text), "\\W+"))
  theme_densities <- sapply(themes, function(theme_words) {
    sum(word_list %in% theme_words) / max(length(word_list), 1)
  })
  
  return(data.frame(
    sentiment_mean = sentiment_mean,
    sentiment_volatility = sentiment_volatility,
    sentiment_range = sentiment_range,
    theme_justice = theme_densities["theme_justice"],
    theme_self = theme_densities["theme_self"],
    theme_spirituality = theme_densities["theme_spirituality"],
    theme_money = theme_densities["theme_money"]
  ))
}


thematic_features <- do.call(rbind, lapply(tpab_raw$lyrics, extract_thematic_features))



tpab_features <- tpab_raw %>%
  select(track_name, album, release_date, duration_ms, popularity, 
         speechiness, danceability, tempo) %>%
  bind_cols(thematic_features)


output_dir <- "data/processed"
if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) {
  cat("4. Creating directory:", output_dir, "\n")
  dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

output_path <- file.path(output_dir, "tpab_features_full.csv")
write.csv(tpab_features, output_path, row.names = FALSE)
print(head(tpab_features, 2))
```
